SELECT 'CMD-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(SEQ_T_AGENT_COMMAND.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_AGENT_COMMAND ( CMD_ID, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CMD_TYPE, PAYLOAD, STATUS, TIMEOUT_SEC, REG_USER_ID, ISSUED_AT ) VALUES ( #{cmdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cmdType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payload,jdbcType=CLOB}, 'W', #{timeoutSec,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{regUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT CMD_ID, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CMD_TYPE, PAYLOAD, STATUS, TIMEOUT_SEC, RESULT_CD, RESULT_DATA, ERR_MSG, REG_USER_ID, ISSUED_AT, ACK_AT, COMPLETED_AT FROM T_AGENT_COMMAND WHERE CMD_ID = #{cmdId}

SELECT CMD_ID, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CMD_TYPE, PAYLOAD, STATUS, TIMEOUT_SEC, RESULT_CD, RESULT_DATA, ERR_MSG, REG_USER_ID, ISSUED_AT, ACK_AT, COMPLETED_AT FROM T_AGENT_COMMAND WHERE TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND TERM_ID = #{termId} AND STATUS = 'W' ORDER BY ISSUED_AT, CMD_ID OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE T_AGENT_COMMAND SET STATUS = 'A', ACK_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CMD_ID = #{cmdId} AND STATUS = 'W'

UPDATE T_AGENT_COMMAND SET STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=CHAR}, RESULT_CD = #{resultCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RESULT_DATA = #{resultData,jdbcType=CLOB}, ERR_MSG = #{errMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMPLETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CMD_ID = #{cmdId} AND STATUS IN ('W', 'A')
mapper.select: SELECT CMD_ID, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CMD_TYPE, PAYLOAD, STATUS, TIMEOUT_SEC, RESULT_CD, RESULT_DATA, ERR_MSG, REG_USER_ID, ISSUED_AT, ACK_AT, COMPLETED_AT FROM T_AGENT_COMMAND WHERE STATUS IN ('W', 'A') AND ISSUED_AT + NUMTODSINTERVAL(TIMEOUT_SEC, 'SECOND') < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY ISSUED_AT OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
